packageRules.description: Auto-merge all minor and patch updates

customManagers.description: Track the Antora UI bundle release pinned in playbook.yml. Without this the URL is invisible to Renovate: an audit of 37 repositories pinning these bundles found none with a manager for it, which is why pins here and elsewhere sat years behind. versioning is set explicitly because vshn/antora-ui-default changed tag format mid-stream (2.3.1, then v2.3.2, v2.3.3) and semver has to normalise the v prefix for the comparison to work.
